"Suported Dwarf The Second by Dopaminis" by Leighbar: https://www.thingiverse.com/thing:4424041

While looking for a Troll Slayer to use in Warhammer Quest I found this great Demon Slayer model, which Leighbar has rescaled and supported. Unfortunately the original seems have disapeared along with its creator. I have used meshmixer to remove the supports to restore the original version so you can support it yourself and rescale it freely.

Leigabar notes their version was "scaled down by +/- 8% so he would be on par with WizKids Nolzur's and DeepCuts minis."
I have kept it at that scale so if you want the original size you'll need to scale it back up to ~108.7%.

https://castlevania.fandom.com/wiki/White_Dragon

A Patreon poll winner, the White Dragon / Bone Dragon enemy from the Castlevania series! Don't blame me for the name confusion, blame Konami!

This is a 28mm ~ 32mm scale miniature suitable for tabletop roleplaying games such as Dungeons and Dragons or Pathfinder (Large creature / base size).

[Here is a pre-supported Chitubox file for resin printing!](https://drive.google.com/open?id=1dd14cK8mFgvXXsjqjRoslxF6OubqOh8Z)
A more tame pose for easy FDM printing is included (labeled FDM).

[If you liked this model and want to show your thanks, you can buy me a coffee!](https://ko-fi.com/clayrade)

[And follow me on Instagram!](https://www.instagram.com/clay.rade/)
